Hi Samira — thanks for the clear brief. Happy to outline three paths so you can pick the tradeoff that fits Arcadia's runway and SLOs. High level:

Option A — Predictable: 12-mo term, move to 16-GPU monthly commit, 10% discount on unit rate. Activation in two waves (8→12 after signing, 12→16 after validation) with pro-rated billing the day each wave goes live.

Option B — Phased ramp (lower immediate commit): 12-mo term with a 12-GPU commit month 1, automatic bump to 16 after month 3, smaller monthly commitment until bump. Lower immediate spend, slightly higher unit rate during phase-in.

Option C — Short term trial + reserve: 6-mo term, 16 GPU reserve for peak windows only (burst billing), plus baseline 8-GPU commit. Good if you need capacity for occasional retraining bursts without full commit.

For the throughput warranty: we can offer a written addendum guaranteeing median token throughput per GPU consistent with our verified profile for your model family (we'll baseline using your 2k seq benchmarks). For tail-latency we offer fallback routing to a near-region pool with an escalation SLA (we can put 99th percentile per-token latency target in the addendum for the committed capacity). I'll loop Sales Ops for final pricing + an order form and our standard "Throughput Warranty" addendum.

Next steps from our side: I will draft an order form with Option A pricing and include the addendum; if you'd prefer B or C we'll adjust. Do you have a preferred go-live window? If you want to align activation with your retraining cadence, tell me the training week(s) and we'll overlay the activation schedule.
